description: Target schema for SMO-016E data once received. astronaut.load_smo016e() maps the delivered file into this shape; no downstream code changes are needed.
grain: one row per subject per timepoint

timepoint.description: Timepoint label as delivered by LSDA

analyte_columns.convention: <analyte>_value and <analyte>_unit, mirroring the OSDR TRANSFORMED convention already handled by astronaut.py

notes: Reference ranges, if supplied, are read as <analyte>_range_min / <analyte>_range_max, matching how OSD-575 is already handled.
The eight-timepoint non-attributable summarisation used in Zheng et al. 2023 is sufficient; per-draw values are not required.
Data placed here are excluded from version control; see .gitignore.
